description: Compare renting a car at Seatac (SEA) for a stay with a private ride from the airport and back, as seatac.co/seatac-car-rental does: typical SEA daily rate, taxes and airport fees, the facility charge, and hotel parking every night (gas left out), against example sedan fares. Override the daily rate or hotel parking with the traveler's own quote. Returns the breakdown, which is cheaper, a ride booking link, and a rental search link (partner; seatac.co may earn a commission). Optional live fare with address + pickup_datetime (one rate-limited quote).

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

hotel_parking_per_night.description: Optional: the hotel's overnight parking per night, USD.

nights.description: Nights in town (1-30); the rental runs one day per night.

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

rental_daily_rate.description: Optional: the traveler's own daily rental rate before tax, USD.

start_date.description: Optional rental pickup date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the rental search link.

name: compare_rental_vs_ride
title: Compare SEA rental car vs a ride
